title: Eustathius, Commentary on Dionysius Periegetes / Евстафий Солунский, Комментарий к Дионисию Периэгету
author: Eustathius of Thessalonica
edition: Müller, Geographi Graeci Minores II (1861), PD. Bernhardy 1828, PD.
ru_evidence: Ru-wiki lists only Ilyushechkina's Russian translation of Dionysius himself (VDI 2005–06). Latyshev's Scythica may contain small excerpts (not verified).
en_evidence: English Wikipedia ('Eustathius of Thessalonica') lists only old editions of this commentary and no translation. Searches found none.
value: Byzantine geography with extracts from lost geographers and historians. The Pontic and Scythian material is of direct interest to Russian readers, and the commentary pairs with the existing Russian Dionysius.
ai_feasibility: Medium. Toponym-heavy and digressive, but syntactically easier than the Homer commentaries. Needs place-name linking.
pilot_unit: Commentary on Dionysius' Pontus and Scythia sections; est. 10–12k words.
